snippet.title: Goodbye GTA 5… Thank You for 13 Incredible Years 🥹❤️ #Shorts #gta6 #gta #gta5
snippet.description:
Goodbye GTA V. 13 years of unforgettable memories. 🥹❤️

September 17, 2013 — the day Rockstar Games gave us a world we’d never forget.

For over 13 years, GTA 5 has been more than just a video game. From our first adventures in Los Santos to countless hours in GTA Online, it became a huge part of our lives. 🎮

❤️ A special thank you to the legends who brought these iconic characters to life:

🎭 Ned Luke — Michael De Santa
🔥 Steven Ogg — Trevor Philips
💚 Shawn Fonteno — Franklin Clinton

Thank you for the laughs, the chaos, the memories, and an unforgettable generation of gaming.

As we look forward to GTA 6 and Vice City, Los Santos will always have a special place in our hearts. 🌴

One last question… Team Michael, Franklin, or Trevor? 🥹👇

snippet.title: Thanks for Everything GTA V🥹
snippet.description:
After more than a decade, it’s finally time to say goodbye to GTA V. ❤️ From the moment we first stepped into Los Santos with Michael, Franklin and Trevor, Grand Theft Auto V gave us an unforgettable experience that shaped an entire generation of gamers.

Whether it was exploring the streets of Los Santos, driving through the mountains, causing chaos, completing heists, meeting unforgettable characters or simply spending hours in GTA Online, GTA V gave us countless memories that will never be forgotten.

Rockstar Games created something truly special. A game that managed to stay relevant for over 10 years, bringing together millions of players and constantly giving us new things to discover. From the iconic locations to the smallest details, Los Santos will always have a special place in gaming history.

But now, a new chapter is approaching. GTA VI is bringing us to Vice City and the state of Leonida, introducing a completely new world, new characters, new stories and what could become the biggest Grand Theft Auto experience yet.

The excitement for GTA VI is real, and we can’t wait to see what Rockstar has been working on. But before we move on to the next generation, let’s take a moment to appreciate everything GTA V gave us.

Goodbye, Los Santos. Thank you for the memories. 🥹

#GTAV #GTA6 #RockstarGames #shorts

snippet.title: Goodbye GTA 5 — Thank You for Everything
snippet.description:
Ten years ago, when I first started playing GTA Online, I found someone who looked like Ed Sheeran. Naturally, I followed him around and made a nuisance of myself… and that little adventure became a hit on my YouTube channel. 😂

Now, for my final time playing GTA 5, I’m heading back to the streets of Los Santos to look for him once again. One last search, one last wander, and a chance to relive the memories that started it all.

I miss those early days. Before flying cars took over the skies, my favourite moments were just meeting people, chatting rubbish, and messing around online. No big plan, just a laugh—and somehow, those were the moments that stayed with me.

So this is my farewell to a game that gave me years of chaos, laughter, and stories to tell. Can I find my “Ed Sheeran” lookalike ten years later? Come along for one last adventure. ❤️

If you enjoy the video, give it a LIKE and SUBSCRIBE to SourDazza for more gaming adventures! Tell me your favourite GTA Online memory in the comments. 👇

Farewell, GTA 5. Thanks for the memories.
